source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: You can always find a place to perform, and performance earns you more than applause. In any settlement with an inn, entertainment district, or public venue you can secure free lodging and a meal in exchange for an evening's entertainment. After spending one evening performing in a location, the GM reveals one piece of relevant local information, rumor, or secret to you, as people speak freely around the entertainment.
